chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Yasar al-Khadim, from al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
The melon eaten on an empty stomach causes the stroke; we seek refuge with Allah from it.

key_terms.عَلَى الرِّيقِ: On an empty stomach / before eating anything else

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of eating melon on an empty stomach according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) warns that consuming melon on an empty stomach may induce 'falaj' (stroke or paralysis), a diagnosis rooted in the Shia tradition of humoral medicine where the fruit's moisture and coldness disrupt bodily balance. This narration, recorded in al-Kafi, underscores the integration of physical health with spiritual mindfulness, as the Imam concludes by seeking refuge in Allah, linking dietary prudence to divine protection from physical affliction.
